data.title: 祀 · 晨光窗台沏一盏清茶
data.action: 坐在窗边木桌前双手推递热茶
data.description: 【祀 · 晨光窗台沏一盏清茶】清晨基地生活区洒满金色晨光，祀拢了拢宽松的薄荷绿落肩开衫，纤细的手指轻捏白瓷茶夹，将刚沏好的清茶推到你面前。澄净的蓝眸含着温软的笑意，青翠的龙角在晨曦中泛着剔透的微光——「新采的茶芽，水温正好，趁热尝尝吧。」
data.promptProse: Si sits beside a sunlit window in a soft mint cardigan, leaning forward slightly as she slides a steaming ceramic teacup across the wooden table with a gentle, warm smile.
data.animaCaption: She slides the steaming teacup forward across the wooden table with both hands as sunlight slants through the window.
